negative_results: A family of more than one test (counting hidden retries) with no correction is refused: refuse_uncorrected_multiple_comparisons raises because the smallest raw p-value is small by construction and the true false-positive rate is the look-elsewhere probability 1-(1-alpha)^m, not alpha.

The look-elsewhere inflation is demonstrated on synthetic null data: reporting the smallest of m=20 uncorrected p-values fires at ~0.64 (matching 1-0.95^20), while the same families corrected by Bonferroni fire at <= alpha.
Hidden retries increase the trial count and the correction: a p-value of 0.004 that passes Bonferroni against 3 reported tests fails once 40 undisclosed retries are counted (43 trials).

Optional stopping is refused: stopping on significance with no preregistered stopping rule raises via the R13 authority (refuse_optional_stopping); peeking at four looks with the full alpha inflates the false-positive rate above 0.10 while the alpha-spending boundary holds it at alpha.

Exploratory scans cannot yield confirmatory p-values: refuse_exploratory_as_confirmatory raises without a sealed preregistration, because the top hit of a ranked family was chosen after seeing the data and was never predicted.
Diagnostics fire on pathological inputs: an implausible |z| (> 6) and a collapsed null variance (< 1e-6) are flagged as prompts to check the null model, never as detections.
No physical measurement was performed; measured_here is nothing and PHYSICAL_VALIDATION_NOT_CLAIMED. Correcting p-values and spending alpha remove inflation but confirm nothing.
reopening_test: Reopen the multiple-comparisons/sequential-analysis firewall if: a family of more than one test (including hidden retries) ever reports an uncorrected smallest p as significant; a stop on significance is ever accepted with no preregistered stopping rule or alpha-spending boundary; an exploratory top hit is ever read as a confirmatory p-value; an alpha-spending schedule's cumulative spend ever exceeds the target alpha or fails to be monotonic to exactly alpha at the final look; a Benjamini-Hochberg or Holm correction fails to recover planted true effects while controlling error on the synthetic fixture; the naive full-alpha peeking rate fails to exceed the spent-boundary rate; or any result here is emitted above SOFTWARE_IMPLEMENTED / SYNTHETIC_OBSERVATION. A physical confirmatory run is reopened only when a preregistered contrast is sealed before the data and real calibrated acquisition with a raw artifact, a clock binding, an environment log and an uncertainty budget exists.
